title: Software Developer
_note: Tasks from eMASCO (emasco.mohr.gov.my/masco/2512), fetched 21 Oct 2026. Questions are ours; each cites the task it was built from.

questions.text: Tell us about a time you worked out what a piece of software needed to do before you built it. How did you find out the requirements?
questions.source: eMASCO 2512, task 1: Menyelidik, menganalisis dan menilai keperluan aplikasi perisian dan sistem operasi.

questions.text: Walk us through how you designed a program or app you built. Why did you structure it that way?
questions.source: eMASCO 2512, task 2: Menyelidik, mereka bentuk dan membangunkan sistem perisian komputer.

questions.text: Describe a time you fixed a bug in code that already existed. How did you find the cause without breaking anything else?
questions.source: eMASCO 2512, task 5: Mengubahsuai perisian sedia ada untuk membetulkan ralat dan menyesuaikannya dengan perkakasan baru…
